text:
erin: Running the onboarding sampleapp and hit inflight > window when token refresh happens mid-pagination.

sam: Logs?

erin: snippet:
INFO id=p45 inflight=5 status=401
INFO refresh start
INFO refresh done
INFO retry id=p45 inflight=6 duplicate send -> upstream 429

kevin: Likely the client doesn't release the permit on the error path before retry. Py SDK releases on terminal states.

erin: Quick hack: have auth middleware releasePermit() before refresh and reacquire after. Long-term: use lease ids so retries reuse same slot.

sam: I'll add a small integration test that simulates mid-batch expiry. Can you file a ticket?

devex-bot: Created ticket RDW-3601: "sampleapp inflight overshoot on auth-retry".
